description: Marion, IA – Congresswoman Ashley Hinson launched “Local Leaders for Hinson,” a coalition of mayors, county supervisors, county treasurers, county auditors, and other local elected officials who are backing her campaign for U.S. Senate. “I’m humbled to have the support of local leaders from across Iowa who want to keep our state moving forward. The best ideas don’t come from Washington — they come from our local communities. I’ve worked with local leaders to turn those ideas into reality, delivering the federal support needed to fund projects that improve everyday life for Iowans,”said Ashley Hinson. “Josh Turek will take his orders from Chuck Schumer and Washington liberals. I’ll answer to Iowans in the U.S. Senate — working with our local leaders to create jobs, strengthen our communities, and lower costs for families, farmers, and small businesses.” “I always say our greatest asset in West Des Moines is our people. Ashley Hinson was born and raised in West Des Moines and graduated from Valley High School – she is no exception to this,” said Mayor of West Des Moines Russ Trimble. “She’s kind, caring, compassionate, and always works hard to come up with commonsense solutions to improve the lives of Iowans and move our state […]

title: Ashley Hinson Launches "Local Leaders for Hinson" Coalition - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
